pattern_summary: Dominant errors: sample_size from validation-scale or population N (7/10); outcome_domain missing anxiety on youth mental-health apps; dissolved-in-media exposure on human biomarker PDFs; weekly app reporting as administration_frequency; lifecourse follow-up as duration_days.
implementation_notes: Reject prior-publication validation sample N and population totals; prefer included-for-extraction cohort counts.
Strip dissolved-in-media exposure when clinical human subjects dominate.
Map youth mental-health assessment apps to anxiety outcome domain.
Skip administration_frequency for mobile-app weekly reporting schedules.
Skip duration_days for birth-cohort / adolescence-to-adulthood lifecourse spans.
RL feedback: local-only staged patch by default; refresh holdout after code deploy (no in-cycle PDF re-run).
